ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT & DECLARATION OF COVENANTS ANDRESTRICTIONS THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT&DECLARATION May, 2013, by and between 14 EAST FIFTY-FIFTH STREET NEW YORK LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with offices c/o Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide, Inc, One StarPoint, Stamford, Connecticut 06902, Attention: General Counsel ("Lower Parcel Owner"), and 14 EAST FIFTY-FIFTH AIR PARCEL, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with offices at c/o Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide, Inc, One StarPoint, Stamford, Connecticut 06902, Attention: General Counsel ("Air Parcel Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Lower Parcel Owner is the owner infee of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork,known as Lot 62 in Block 1290 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,for the County of New York (the “Tax Map") and as and by the street address of 14 East 55"h Street, part hereof (the“Existing Parcel") and of all buildings and improvements presently located thereon (the “Existing Building"; the Existing Building and any building that may hereafter be constructed in replacement in whole or in part of the Existing Building with the Retained Development Rights (hereafter defined) in accordance with this Agreement are referred to herein asthe“LowerParcelBuilding"); WHEREAS, immediately after recording this Agreement, Lower Parcel Owner will subdivide the Existing Parcel into two parcels of land constituting two separate tax lots consisting of a parcel below a limiting plane (the “Limiting Plane") located at an elevation of one hundred and forty (140") feet above the Datum Level (hereafter defined) (the “Lower Parcel") (the Lower Parcel Building together with the Lower Parcel are sometimes referred to hereinafter collectively as the “Lower Development Parcel"), more particularly described in Schedule“B" annexed hereto, and a parcel above the Limiting Plane (the“Air Parcel") and the Excess Development Rights (hereafter defined), more particularly described in Schedule “"C" annexed hereto; WHEREAS, upon completion of the subdivision, the fee for the Air Parcel and the Excess Development. Rights will be transferred and conveyed to Air Parcel Owner, and, upon such transfer and conveyance, Air Parcel Owner shall be the owner of (a) fee simple title to the AirParcel (the Lower Parcel and theAirParcel are sometimes referred to hereinafter collectively as the “Parcels” and each, individually, as a “Parcel"), and (b) the Excess Development Rights (as hereafter defined); WHEREAS, the Existing Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereafter defined), than is now available for use on the Existing Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that, after taking into account the floor area currently used by the Existing Building, Excess Development Rights are available for transfer to and utilization on another tax lot that ispart of the same zoninglot as theExistingParcel; NY242964644v3

WHEREAS, the Land Parcel and the Air Parcel comprise a single zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lot") pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated ofevendateherewithandintendedtoberecordedsimultaneouslyherewithintheOfficeof the City Register, for the County of New York (the “Register's Office"); WHEREAS, Air Parcel Owner may hereafter merge the Land Parcel and the Air Parcel into an enlarged Combined Zoning Lot (the “Enlarged Combined Zoning Lot") to transfer some portion or all of the Excess Development Rights to one or more other tax lots in Block 1290 that are adjacent to and contiguous with the Existing Parcel or to a remote zoning lot to the extent permitted by the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, Air Parcel Owner and Land Parcel Owner wish to allocate their respective rights in the Combined Zoning Lot and to provide to the maximum extent possible for NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions.As used herein: (a) “AdditionalDevelopmentRights” shall mean any additional Development Rights that may become available to the Combined Zoning Lot or the Enlarged Combined Zoning Lot, either by expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot by the addition of Additional Parcels, as hereinafter defined, or as Bonus Development Rights; (b)“"Additional Parcels" shall mean any parcels of real property that are located in Block 1290 on the Tax Map, other than those parcels which currently comprise the Combined Zoning Lot, which become part of the Combined Zoning Lot or parcels of real property that are treated, for purposes of the Zoning Resolution, as permitted transferee parcels of the Excess Development Rights; to theAirParcel,the sum of the Excess Development Rights and anyAdditional Development Rights hereafter acquired by Air Parcel Owner. other development rights attributable to the Combined Zoning Lot which may be or become availableforinclusion in abuilding constructed thereon through the provision of an amenity or public benefit, either on or off the Combined Zoning Lot, or pursuant to a special perimit, variance, or other procedure or transfer allowed under the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, Sections 81-63 et seq., 81-212, 81-254, 81-266, 81- 277, 34-223, 35-35, 74-79 et seq. and 23-90 et seq. thereof); in accordance with the applicable provisions of theZoningResolution. 2 NY242964644v3
